fullContentHtml:
SBI PO Pre Mains Admit Card 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : State Bank of India (SBI) has released the Mains Admit Card for the recruitment of Probationary Officers on the official website. Online registration process for SBI PO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from from 18 June 2026, to 08 July 2026. There is a total of 1,500 vacancies has been issued in the SBI PO Recruitment 2026. The mains examination is going to conducted on 12 September 2026. Candidates who appeared for Pre examination can download their SBI PO Mains Admit Card 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 18 June 2026
  • Last Date : 08 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 08 July 2026
  • Pre Exam Training PET : 17 July 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 01-02 August 2026
  • Pre Admit Available : 22 July 2026
  • Pre Result : 28 August 2026
  • Pre Score Card : 01 September 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 12 September 2026
  • Mains Admit Available : 02 September 2026
  • Mains Result : September/October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
